text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I love running! It's so exciting and fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I think it'll be even more fun if I can
get
first
place! So I'm going to try my best to
win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
